checks.name: Body ≤ 4,000 words
checks.note: The word count limitation does not include references. Counts every active section, Key Takeaways included; the venue counts those separately.

checks.name: 1–3 key-takeaway bullets supplied
checks.note: Each a sentence; the journal publishes them with the abstract.

checks.name: Sections match the journal's structure
checks.note: Every section marked required in the structure file must be present and non-empty

checks.name: Cover letter present
checks.note: A statement that the paper has not been previously published and is not under consideration by another journal; a brief description of the research, why it is important, its key takeaways, and why the journal's readers would be interested; and any funding or potential conflict of interest disclosures (with how the submission differs from any related preprint, dissertation or paper, and any use of AI tools).

checks.name: Conflicts summarised in the manuscript; a signed ICMJE form for every author
checks.note: Every author declares on the cover page at submission; the forms by the latest revision — one per author even with nothing to disclose.

checks.name: Conflict of interest disclosures for every author
checks.note: Complete disclosure of all relevant financial relationships; authors with none say so.

checks.name: Teaser Text ≤ 200 words
checks.note: No longer than 200 words: a brief promotional text that entices a reader to click through, published online in the table of contents. No citations; define any abbreviations.

checks.name: Tables numbered, cited in the text, editable (not images), at the end of the main text
checks.note: Units in column or row headers, not the body; symbols such as asterisks explained in a footnote; no color, shading or tab-alignment.

checks.name: Figures as separate files with titles, legends and captions in the manuscript
checks.note: .jpeg, .jpg, .tiff, .svg, .pdf or .eps (never .bmp, .gif or .docx); one file per figure, named to match its citation (fig1.tiff); multi-panel figures as one file with panels lettered A, B, C in the upper-left; vector art as .eps/.pdf/.svg with fonts embedded; raster at 300 dpi (color half-tones), 600 dpi (grayscale, combinations), 1200 dpi (fine line art).

checks.name: Alt text under every figure legend, preceded by "Alt text:"
checks.note: Required for all images, figures, illustrations and photographs in the main article; concise and informative, so a screen-reader user understands the figure.

checks.name: References carry the DOI and eLocator of every online-only article
checks.note: Any readable style at submission (the journal follows AMA); authors are responsible for accuracy. Example: Health Affairs Scholar. 2023;1(1):qxad009. https://doi.org/10.1093/haschl/qxad009

checks.name: Supplementary material cited in the text and submitted with the manuscript
checks.note: Online only, not copyedited; documentation and appendices as PDF, data as .zip; hosted by OUP or a partner such as Dryad — never a personal, institutional or Google Docs link. What is necessary to understand the article stays in the manuscript.
